newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen slowing three-day fall.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen slowing three-day fall.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to slow their three-session fall on Thursday after buying picked up somewhat after price-fixing on Wednesday.

Analysts said May earnings results, most released on Wednesday, could cause sharper-than-usual price swings for some stocks though the overall market should maintain its three-month flat trend in coming weeks.

Analysts said shares could get a lift from Wednesday's news Bank Handlowy's privatisation offer was oversubsubscribed, though the upcoming offering of copper firm KGHM Polska Miedz could draw capital from stocks.
